learning_outcomes.text: Describe common energy stores such as kinetic, gravitational, elastic and chemical
Explain that energy can be transferred and is conserved overall
Relate the speed and mass of an object to its kinetic energy
Describe how height gives an object gravitational potential energy
Explain simply how friction transfers energy to the surroundings
Apply safe practice when investigating moving objects

integrative_case: Zara investigates a safe ramp-and-trolley setup: she releases a trolley from different heights, explains how gravitational energy becomes kinetic energy, where friction sends some energy, and the safety rules she followed with the ramp.
